---
title: "Inclusions Detection Model Training"
format: html
---

Training **inclusions detection** model for petrographic analysis with extended training (4000 iterations).

## Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(magick)
library(jsonlite)
library(fs)
library(here)
library(hipergator)
library(petrographer)

# Configure HPC settings once
hpg_configure(
  host = "hpg",
  base_dir = "/blue/nicolas.gauthier/nicolas.gauthier/petrographer"
)

data_dir <- here("data/processed/inclusions_sliced")

# Validate dataset
validate_dataset(data_dir)
```

## Training

```{r training}
# Train model - HPC settings configured above
model_path <- train_model(
  data_dir = data_dir,
  output_name = "inclusions",
  ims_per_batch = 16,
  num_workers = 16,
  hpc_cpus_per_task = 18,
  hpc_mem = "96gb",
  eval_period = 150,
  max_iter = 1500,
  num_classes = 1,
  learning_rate = 1e-4
)
```

## Annotation Diagnostics

```{r annotation-diagnostics}
# Diagnose training and validation annotations
train_diag <- diagnose_annotations(
  annotation_json = path(data_dir, "train/_annotations.coco.json"),
  image_dir = path(data_dir, "train")
)

val_diag <- diagnose_annotations(
  annotation_json = path(data_dir, "valid/_annotations.coco.json"),
  image_dir = path(data_dir, "valid")
)
```

```{r annotation-plots}
# Plot distribution of annotations per image
library(ggplot2)

train_anno_dist <- tibble(
  count = train_diag$annos_per_image_tbl$annotation_count,
  split = "train"
)

val_anno_dist <- tibble(
  count = val_diag$annos_per_image_tbl$annotation_count,
  split = "valid"
)

bind_rows(train_anno_dist, val_anno_dist) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = count, fill = split)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, alpha = 0.6, position = "identity") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  annotate("text", x = 100, y = Inf, label = "Default maxDets=100",
           vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.1, color = "red", size = 3) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  labs(
    title = "Annotations per Image Distribution",
    subtitle = "Red line shows default COCO evaluation limit (100 detections)",
    x = "Number of annotations",
    y = "Number of images",
    fill = "Split"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Object size distribution
train_size_dist <- tibble(
  area = train_diag$annotations$area,
  split = "train"
)

val_size_dist <- tibble(
  area = val_diag$annotations$area,
  split = "valid"
)

bind_rows(train_size_dist, val_size_dist) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = log10(area), fill = split)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, alpha = 0.6, position = "identity") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  labs(
    title = "Object Size Distribution",
    x = "log10(Area) in pixels²",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Split"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Evaluation

```{r evaluation}
# Load training metrics
eval_result <- evaluate_training(model_path)
```

```{r plots}
# Loss
eval_result$training_data |>
  select(iteration, contains("loss")) |>
  pivot_longer(-iteration, names_to = "loss_type", values_to = "loss") |>
  filter(!is.na(loss)) |>
  ggplot(aes(iteration, loss)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~loss_type, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Training Loss - inclusions_v2") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Validation metrics  
eval_result$validation_data |>
    pivot_longer(-iteration, names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") |>
    filter(!is.na(value)) |>
    ggplot(aes(iteration, value)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point(size = 0.5) +
    facet_wrap(~metric, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(title = "Validation Metrics - inclusions_v2") +
    theme_minimal()
```

## SAHI COCO Evaluation

Evaluate the model on the validation set using SAHI inference and compute COCO metrics.

```{r sahi-eval}
# Load trained model
model <- load_model(
  model_path = path(model_path, "model_final.pth"),
  config_path = path(model_path, "config.yaml")
)

# Run SAHI evaluation on validation set
val_annotation_json <- path(data_dir, "valid/_annotations.coco.json")
val_image_dir <- path(data_dir, "valid")

sahi_eval <- evaluate_model_sahi(
  model = model,
  annotation_json = val_annotation_json,
  image_dir = val_image_dir,
  use_slicing = FALSE,
  slice_size = 640,
  max_dets = 300,
  overlap = 0.2
)

# Display COCO metrics
cat("\n== COCO Evaluation Metrics (SAHI) ==\n")
print(sahi_eval$summary, n = Inf)

# Save predictions for later analysis
sahi_pred_path <- path(eval_result$output_dir, "sahi_validation_predictions.csv")
readr::write_csv(sahi_eval$predictions, sahi_pred_path)
cat(sprintf("\nSaved %d predictions to: %s\n", nrow(sahi_eval$predictions), sahi_pred_path))
```

```{r detection-analysis}
# Compare predictions per image vs ground truth
gt_anno <- jsonlite::read_json(val_annotation_json)
gt_per_image <- table(map_int(gt_anno$annotations, "image_id"))

pred_per_image <- sahi_eval$predictions %>%
  count(image_id, name = "n_predictions")

# Join with ground truth
comparison <- tibble(
  image_id = as.integer(names(gt_per_image)),
  n_gt = as.numeric(gt_per_image)
) %>%
  left_join(pred_per_image, by = "image_id") %>%
  mutate(
    n_predictions = replace_na(n_predictions, 0),
    recall_estimate = n_predictions / n_gt,
    missing = n_gt - n_predictions
  )

cat("\n== Detection Coverage Summary ==\n")
cat(sprintf("Mean GT objects per image: %.1f\n", mean(comparison$n_gt)))
cat(sprintf("Mean predictions per image: %.1f\n", mean(comparison$n_predictions)))
cat(sprintf("Mean recall estimate: %.1f%%\n", 100 * mean(comparison$recall_estimate)))
cat(sprintf("Images with >100 GT objects: %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            sum(comparison$n_gt > 100), 100 * mean(comparison$n_gt > 100)))
cat(sprintf("Images with >100 predictions: %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            sum(comparison$n_predictions > 100), 100 * mean(comparison$n_predictions > 100)))

# Show images with highest detection deficit
cat("\n== Images with Most Missing Detections ==\n")
comparison %>%
  arrange(desc(missing)) %>%
  head(10) %>%
  select(image_id, n_gt, n_predictions, recall_estimate, missing) %>%
  print()
```

```{r detection-coverage-plot}
# Plot predictions vs ground truth
comparison %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = n_gt, y = n_predictions)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Predictions vs Ground Truth Annotations",
    subtitle = "Points below line = under-detection; above line = may indicate missing GT",
    x = "Ground Truth Annotations",
    y = "Model Predictions"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Histogram of recall per image
comparison %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = recall_estimate)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "Per-Image Recall Distribution",
    subtitle = "Values >1 suggest potential missing ground truth annotations",
    x = "Predictions / Ground Truth",
    y = "Number of images"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r sahi-metrics-plot}
# Plot COCO metrics (note: AR@300 for dense detection)
key_metrics <- c("AP", "AP50", "AP75", "AR@300")
sahi_eval$summary |>
  filter(metric %in% key_metrics) |>
  mutate(metric = factor(metric, levels = key_metrics)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = metric, y = value)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", value)), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
  ylim(0, 1) +
  labs(
    title = "SAHI COCO Evaluation Metrics (Dense Detection)",
    subtitle = sprintf("%d images, %d detections (maxDets=300)",
                       length(unique(sahi_eval$predictions$image_id)),
                       nrow(sahi_eval$predictions)),
    x = "Metric",
    y = "Value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Model Testing

```{r testing}
cat("\n== Testing Model ==\n")

# Test on validation sample
test_images <- dir_ls(here('data/processed/inclusions_sliced/valid'),
                     glob = '*.jpg')

test_image <- test_images[4]

test_result <- predict_image(
  image_path = test_image,
  model = model,
  use_slicing = FALSE,
  output_dir = here('results/inclusions_v3_test')
)

cat(sprintf("Test image: %s\n", path_file(test_image)))
cat(sprintf("Objects detected: %d\n", nrow(test_result)))
cat(sprintf("Mean confidence: %.3f\n", mean(test_result$confidence)))
```


```{r ground-truth-plot}

pred_image <- test_image |>
  path_file() |>
  path_ext_remove() |>
  paste0('_prediction.png')

magick::image_read(test_image) |> plot()
here('results/inclusions_v3_test', pred_image) |>
  magick::image_read() |>
  plot()

pg_plot_annotations(
  image_path = test_image,
  annotation_json = fs::path(data_dir, "valid", "_annotations.coco.json"),
  label_cex = 0.6
)
```
## Summary

```{r summary}
cat("\n== Training Summary ==\n")

if (exists("test_result") && nrow(test_result) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("Model successfully tested with %d detections\n", nrow(test_result)))
}
```
